title: BotLookup is three Options (exact, mine, global) kept in step, and a refused lookup reads as 'no match'
trigger: Type a username on the Chatbots screen; one of the three searches is refused
effect: done() is 'all three Some'; apply_business_extra_error stores Some(None)/Some(vec![]) for a failed part, so a refusal and an empty result look the same and nothing is shown (return true without setting business.error)
fix: BotLookup::{Idle, Asking{generation, exact, mine, global: Fetch<..>}} with Fetch::Failed per part

title: Own speaking edge is lost when setGroupCallParticipantIsSpeaking fails to send
trigger: Speak in a group call while the sender returns an error for that one request
effect: SpeakingTracker::update records last_sent before the send; a send_json Err is returned from pump_call_audio and swallowed by request_tick (unwrap_or(false)), so the tracker thinks TDLib knows. Others see you stuck speaking or silent until the 500 ms refresh or the next edge
fix: Tracker records a send only after send_speaking returns Ok, or keeps SpeakingSent::{Unsent, Told(bool)}

title: CallAudio::speaking mirrors SpeakingTracker's speaking state and is reset by hand in three places
trigger: pump_call_audio sets speaking false when not wanted, on a tap error, and from update.speaking
effect: No bug today; speaking, tracker.last_sent and the Tap stage must move together
fix: Read speaking from the tracker (one value), reset only through tracker.reset()

title: close_held_until is a close stage kept beside Session::shutdown
trigger: begin_close with a hang-up pending: close_held_until = Some(deadline) while Session::shutdown stays Running until release_close sends request_close
effect: for up to 500 ms the account is closing but chats_path_active() is true, so ingest can still start requests, accept a queued swap call or open work for an account on its way out
fix: make Held{until} a ShutdownPhase variant so chats_path_active() and the hold are one value

title: Community fetches sit in Fetch::Loading{request: None} and are answered by purpose
trigger: joined, owned_bots, add_chat_requests and member_chats are set Loading with request None; apply_communities_payload/apply_communities_error match the answer on pending.purpose (and community id), not on the RequestId the stage holds
effect: a late answer of a dropped or replaced request (e.g. one forgotten by reset_add_chat_requests and asked again) is applied to the newer Loading; is_loading() guards also stay true if the request is lost
fix: call Fetch::sent(extra) after sending and apply answers through Fetch::answered/failed with the RequestId

title: The deep-link stage is reset and rewritten by hand outside its transitions: chats_state.deep_link = None here, and DeepLinkFlow { stage, from_agent } built directly in src/ui/deep_links.rs (lines 107, 179, 540); the invite preview is also held a second time in links.flow.invite()
trigger: Click a t.me link while an invite preview is up, or cancel the invite box
effect: the session stage and the UI's own copy of the preview are kept in step by hand (ask + deep_link = Some, take_invite + deep_link = None); from_agent is dropped or re-derived at each write
fix: one owner of the flow with start/enter/cancel methods only; the UI box reads the stage and cancel calls a single cancel_deep_link(generation); move deep_link_seq into the flow

title: set_direct_topic_read sends the marked-as-unread toggle, then `?` returns if the view_messages send fails, so the two halves of 'Mark as read' are not one step
trigger: Mark a conversation as read when the second send is refused
effect: the manual mark is cleared but the unread count stays; the Result says it failed though half went out
fix: report the partial send, or send the view first and the mark second

title: Withdraw holds the in-flight request twice: Withdraw::request (Option set after the send) and WithdrawStep::PasswordSending(RequestId)
trigger: Collect/Withdraw, then submit the password: send_withdrawal writes withdraw.request, then submit_withdrawal_password writes step PasswordSending(request) separately
effect: two fields that must change together; takes_answer has to compare both; request is None between Some(Withdraw) creation and the send
fix: carry the RequestId only in the step variants (Checking(RequestId), PasswordSending(RequestId)); drop Withdraw::request

title: open_starref_join leaves the found-programs list Idle and never asked when the connected-programs send fails
trigger: Open the affiliate join page while the first send (getConnectedAffiliatePrograms) is refused: fetch_connected_programs(false)? returns early, fetch_found_programs is never sent
effect: 'All programs' list stays empty with no spinner and no Retry (retry_starref_programs only acts on PageLoad::Failed); only reopening the page asks
fix: send both lists independent of each other and fail the unsent one (inspect_err sets PageLoad::Failed) so Retry shows

title: join_affiliate_program swallows a refused send: returns Ok(()) after resetting the stage to Open
trigger: Press Join Program while the sender refuses the request
effect: caller (UI) sees success and shows no error; box silently stays open
fix: return the send result (or push an EarnState note) when the stage is reset

title: EarnPage::ton / stars (Load::Loading) carry no RequestId; TonStats/StarStats answers and errors are matched by peer only
trigger: Open the revenue page of a peer, close, reopen same peer (open_earn_page replaces the page and re-sends) while the first TonStats/StarStats answer or error is still in flight
effect: a stale answer (or an error toast/Failed) from the first open lands on the second page's Loading stage, then the second answer overwrites or is ignored; Failed can show while a newer request is still out
fix: Load::Loading(RequestId) and compare with the pending id like ton_history.load.waits_for

title: Trending emoji paging keeps trending_offset (offset of the page in flight), trending_next_offset, trending_total and trending_has_more as four loose fields written by hand at select_emoji_set_tab, more_trending_emoji_packs and accept_trending_emoji_sets
trigger: Open Trending, scroll to load more, switch tabs and back, or have a more-page fail
effect: the answer reads trending_offset to decide replace vs append; a failed/dropped page leaves trending_offset pointing at the failed offset
fix: one Paging value: Start / Next { offset } / Asking { request, offset } / End, with the answer matched by RequestId

title: flood_attempts entries (and the sender's retained json) leak when a re-sent request is swept or taken without any answer
trigger: A read gets a 429, is re-sent after the wait (entry removed from flood_retries), then is dropped by sweep_stale_requests / take_purpose before TDLib answers
effect: the flood_attempts map entry for that RequestId is never removed (small leak); the retained json is only freed on the next answer
fix: derive attempts from the retry entry (attempts inside FloodRetry/request stage) so dropping the request drops the count

title: fetch_folder_share returns early when the invite-links send fails, so the chats half (GetChatsForFolderInviteLink) is never begun and stays Idle
trigger: Open Share Folder while the first send is refused
effect: links show an error with Retry but the chats list stays Idle/blank (no spinner or error) until Retry re-runs both
fix: send both halves, failing each independently, instead of `return Err` after the first

title: refetch_topic after read-all mentions/reactions drops a refused getForumTopic send silently (let _) and has no stale mark
trigger: Mark all mentions as read in a topic while the second send is refused
effect: topic badges stay at the old unread-mention/reaction counts until another update
fix: keep a stale mark per topic that the next ingest retries, or apply the read locally

title: GIF search page offset lives in GifPanel::search_offset and search_next_offset (Strings) outside the GifList::Search stage; written by hand in search_gifs and maybe_search_gifs
trigger: Search GIFs, scroll for more pages, start a new search
effect: search_gifs clears three string/vec fields by hand next to search_begun; paging fields can disagree with the stage
fix: put offset/next_offset/results inside GifSearch (the stage) so a new search replaces them whole

title: preload_craft_lists stops at the first refused send with `?`: when the candidates page fails to send, the 'on sale' list (craft.market.load) is never begun and stays Idle
trigger: Open the craft box while the first send is refused
effect: 'Your gifts' shows an error with Retry; the 'on sale' list stays Idle (blank), and retry_craft_listings only acts on an error() so it can never be retried until the box is reopened
fix: send both lists independently; fail each unsent one

title: follow_gift_auction drops the old follow without checking the closeAuction send: follow is set to None whether or not CloseAuction left
trigger: Switch from one auction box to another (or close) while the sender refuses the follow(false) request
effect: the server keeps sending auction updates for the old gift (session keeps applying them) while Quill believes nothing is followed
fix: AuctionFollow::Closing { gift_id, request } until the close answers or fails

title: request_giveaway_options resets a refused premium/stars send to Fetch::Idle instead of Failed; the caller ignores the Err and nothing asks again
trigger: Open the new-giveaway form while a send is refused (disconnected): options.premium/stars go back to Idle
effect: the form shows no prices, no error and no Retry; options are only asked once at form open
fix: Fetch::Failed with the error line and a Retry that calls request_giveaway_options

title: switch_language sends language_pack_id before the strings; a later failed send resets the stage to Idle without restoring the option
trigger: choose_language: send_language_option(language_pack_id) goes out, then get_language_pack_strings or synchronize fails to send
effect: The interface keeps the old pack but TDLib now serves the new one (restore_language_option is only called after a failed answer, ui/language_ui.rs:304, not after a failed send); the note says the switch failed
fix: Send the option last, or call restore_language_option on any Err from send_language_switch

title: request_gift_code_info writes a new GiftCodeLookup over one that is Applying, dropping its request
trigger: Press Apply in the gift code box (stage Applying{request}), then open another giftcode link before TDLib answers
effect: payments.gift_code becomes Checking(new code); the answer to applyPremiumGiftCode is matched against the Applying request, no longer there, so the success or error of the first apply is never shown even though Premium was applied; on a failed send of the new check the box is dropped to None as well
fix: Refuse (or queue) a new lookup while the stage is Applying, and keep the old lookup when the new send fails

title: ensure_sticker_set_view_files marks SetFiles::Asked before the downloads leave and never clears it on a send failure
trigger: Open a sticker set view while the sender refuses the first downloadFile (client closing or not Ready), then reopen the same view state
effect: The view stays Asked, so the remaining sticker previews are never requested and the grid stays blank until the view is reopened
fix: Set Asked only after ensure_media_files returned Ok, or reset to NotAsked on Err

title: fetch_emoji_pack_title has no in-flight guard, only a cache check
trigger: Right-click an emoji-pack message repeatedly, or open the menu twice before getStickerSet answers
effect: Every open sends another getStickerSet for the same set while the first is pending (wasted requests); the title cache is the only guard and is written on answer
fix: Skip when requests.has_purpose(EmojiPackTitle { set_id }) is true, as the other once-per-key fetches do

title: fetch_message_audience begins the audience then returns on the first failed send, leaving later lists NotAsked
trigger: Open a message menu when the viewers request cannot be sent
effect: The read-date, author and reactions lists are never asked and stay NotAsked for that menu; whether the page shows a spinner or nothing for NotAsked was not traced
fix: Mark each list Failed when its send does not leave, or continue with the other requests before returning the first error

title: SetFiles::{NotAsked, Asked} is marked Asked before the downloads are sent and the send result is dropped
trigger: Open a sticker set box while ensure_media_files fails (path inactive)
effect: Previews of the set are never requested again until the set is re-fetched; cells stay grey placeholders. Called from sticker_set_box/mod.rs:387 as `let _ =`
fix: Mark Asked only after the send went out, or derive from the file map

title: create_managed_bot writes Creating over a createBot still in flight
trigger: A second create_managed_bot call (any caller that is not the Create button, which the dialog disables while creating) while the first answer is out
effect: the stage is replaced with a new generation, the first request is not cancelled, and its answer is dropped by the generation check: a second bot may be created and the first never reported
fix: refuse (InvalidRequest) when the stage is already Creating, so the driver, not the button, owns the one-at-a-time rule; give Creating the RequestId and match on it instead of a shared counter bumped by username checks too

title: release_paid_send remembers the price before the send went out
trigger: Paid-send confirm box with Don't ask again ticked; the connection is closing so send_json fails; user then cancels
effect: remember_paid_trust already trusted and saved the price for the chat although the Stars send never left, so the next send in that chat skips the confirmation
fix: remember the price only after send_json returns Ok (the held send leaves the guard at the same point)

title: checkout invoice is a separate Option next to the checkout stage
trigger: send_payment_form_request / validate_payment_order_info / submit_payment_form each write payments.request, checkout, order_info and shipping_id one by one; only checkout.rs closes them together
effect: no bug today, but a new getPaymentForm overwrites a Ready/Verifying checkout (stage Loading) while payments.request, shipping_id and order_info are reset by hand at each site; shows()/checkout_sending() read request while the stage says another thing
fix: put the invoice (and shipping/order stage) inside the CheckoutForm variants so one value is replaced; refuse a new form while Verifying
